field_meaning.hi: डिवाइस की स्क्रीन पर CSS लागू करता है।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi description says 'डिवाइस की स्क्रीन पर CSS लागू करता है' (Applies CSS on the device's screen). This is slightly imprecise. Media queries apply CSS based on conditions (like screen width), not just 'on the screen'. But it's acceptable.
